text_block_list.text: Alright, time for training today as well!

text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Training, tanmen, El rotation!
I am ready to give it my all, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That didn't quite land, did it, YES?
Even after that, El Condor Pasa couldn't quite land her signature waltz rhythm.

"She's unaware of it herself, but she seems exhausted.
I might need to reconsider her upcoming race schedule..."
